messages.text: I’ve proposed a refund of **BRL 39.00** for the returned silicone watch strap. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a message in chat won’t confirm it. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
The customer confirmed request prop-0ab2cc7291f14971 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.

The BRL 39.00 refund for the silicone watch strap is complete. Receipt: **R-00000001**. In this demonstration, the receipt records the refund in the shop’s test ledger; it isn’t a bank transfer, and the shop can’t provide a date for when money may appear on a card. (refund-policy/v2/payout)
Was the sports watch also refunded?
